newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Man slashes kids' throats in Australia murders.
newsitem.headline: Man slashes kids' throats in Australia murders.

text.p: A man murdered his two young stepchildren, slashing their throats with a kitchen knife, then killed himself by laying in the path of a truck on a busy Australian road, police and media reports said on Thursday.

Police said they believed the 24-year-old man, whose remains have yet to be officially identified, killed the nine-year-old girl and seven-year-old boy in the family home in suburban Melbourne on Wednesday night while their mother was out.
The mother, 33, returned home from playing Bingo to find the two children dead and her husband gone.
Her other two children, an 18-month girl and four-year-old girl, were also at home but were unharmed, police said. Both were thought to have been fathered by the murderer, they added.

An hour after the distraught mother reported the murders and bundled her surviving infants into an ambulance, her husband walked onto a road about three km (two miles) away and was hit by a large truck, the police and media reports said.
"We have no motive at all," said Detective Chief Inspector Rod Collins of Melbourne's homicide squad. "These circumstances are tragic...," he told reporters here.
Two major newspapers on Thursday quoted other police sources as saying the children's throats were cut with what investigators suspect was a kitchen knife.
